question: Why is the triadic manifestation described as a trident and as stainless?
premises: The three powers have become manifest.
The Śrīpūrva teaching calls this triśūla.
Teachers who see reality call it stainless.
inference: The triadic power is symbolized as a trident and recognized as stainless by authoritative teachers.
uncertainties: The symbolic mapping of the three prongs is not specified here.
plain_english: Therefore the Teacher declared this to be the trident in the Śrīpūrva teaching, and teachers who see reality have also called it stainless.
